evals.name: remote-team-connection
evals.prompt: We're a product team at a collaboration software company. Our brief: 'Remote employees feel disconnected from their teams; design a feature that increases team connection, measured by weekly active use of a new team space.' Run a causal layered analysis on this brief before we start designing.
evals.expected_output: CLA across litany, social causes, worldview and myth/metaphor for remote-work disconnection; shows what the brief assumes at each layer, who is expected to act at each layer, and a reframed brief from an alternative metaphor.

evals.name: hospital-wait-times
evals.prompt: A regional hospital asked our service design studio to 'reduce emergency department waiting times with a better triage and queue-status app for patients'. Use causal layered analysis to examine this brief before we commit to the app.
evals.expected_output: CLA of ED waiting times; litany (wait-time headlines), systemic causes (capacity, staffing, primary-care access), worldview (hospital-centred care, patient as queue item), myth/metaphor; scenarios per layer and actions beyond the app.

evals.name: teen-screen-time
evals.prompt: We design a parental-controls product. Leadership wants a 'screen time reduction' feature for teenagers because of news coverage about teen mental health. Apply CLA to the issue and to our brief.
evals.expected_output: CLA moving from media litany about teen screen time through platform economics and family dynamics to worldviews about adolescence and control, with a root metaphor and an alternative one; identifies who solves the problem at each layer.
